About Me

Hi, I’m Emerson A. Brenches. I’m a Computer Science student who enjoys expressing ideas through creative work and visual design. I like taking photos, exploring new places, and trying different styles. I design posters, logos, and social media visuals, and I build with Python and HTML under my brand, Brenches Programming: Programming • Art • Design.

Education

BS Computer Science, Section 3-CS4

Design Philosophy

Progress does not have to be perfect to be meaningful. Every experience becomes part of the story I am still creating.

“Where code meets creativity, ideas become innovative solutions.”
